Bank-grade encryption • Your designs stay yours

Your designs deserve better than a Final_v3 folder.

A searchable library for every design you've ever made.

Find your designs in seconds
Your entire library, organised
Search by reference, category, sale date

No credit card required • Set up in 5 minutes

The problem

Sound familiar?

Organizing designs shouldn't be this hard.

01

Folder chaos

Hours spent digging through "Final_v3" folders just to find that one file

02

No single source of truth

Designs scattered across drives, desktops, and email threads

03

Lost work

That design you made six months ago? Hidden in a subfolder somewhere

04

Spotted in the wild

You see your print out in the wild but can't find the original file to confirm it's yours

Features

Everything you need to feel in control

Your entire design catalog—organized, searchable, and under control.

Visual design library

See all your designs in one beautiful, organized grid.

Your work, beautifully displayed

Instant search

Find any design by name, category, style, status and more.

Your catalog, searchable

Easy import

Start with a CSV and a ZIP of your designs. Finish with a beautiful library.

Up and running in minutes

Private by design

Your designs are encrypted before they ever leave your device. Even we can't see them.

Privacy, not broken promises

Know your sales

Sold designs shown with revenue, time to sell, region and more.

See what's working

Spot underperformers

See what's not selling and dig into why.

Learn from every design

How it works

Set up in 5 minutes

Your designs, organised in minutes.

01

Upload your data

Upload your design data (just a basic .csv). We'll match it automatically.

02

We organize it

PrintPulse structures everything into a searchable catalog.

03

Add your images

Upload a ZIP of your design files. We encrypt them on your device, then match them to your data.

04

Search, browse, discover

Find any design instantly. See what's selling. Spot what's not.

Who it's for

Designers who feel in control

“I love having all my work in one place. I can find anything in seconds and spot trends I'd never noticed before.”
SB
Sarah B.
Print Designer

Built for independent designers

Whether you have 10 designs or 10,000—if you're an independent print designer with an unorganised design library, PrintPulse is for you.
